## Workshop 4: Metagenome Function

### Step 1: Assembly

make flye directory

``` bash
mkdir flye
```

symbolic link to the bbd read data

``` bash
ln -s /pvol/data/metagenome_assembly/bbd_0.1.fastq.gz .
```

creating new shell script called run_flye_bbd.sh Had to remove the "raw_data" portion of the script in the file pathway for the code to be successful

``` bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=720
#SBATCH --ntasks=12 --mem=10gb

echo "Starting flye bbd in $(pwd) at $(date)"

flye --nano-hq ../bbd_0.1.fastq.gz --threads 12 --out-dir bbd --meta

echo "Finished flye bbd in $(pwd) at $(date)"
```

submitted job

``` bash
sbatch run_flye_bbd.sh
```
